description: Translate text between 13+ languages with an LLM. Arabic-first quality, with formality control (formal/informal) and optional context to disambiguate meaning. Handles both short dictionary-style word lookups and full documents. Returns the translation and, when available, alternative phrasings.

context.description: Optional background text that improves accuracy (it is not translated).

target_lang.description: Target language, as a name or code (e.g. English, Arabic, ar, ja, fr).

name: translate_text
